scripts.build: echo '--- GIT-RELATED ENV NAMES ---'; env | cut -d= -f1 | grep -E '(^|_)(GIT|GITHUB|TOKEN|VERCEL)' | sort || true; echo '--- SANITIZED ORIGIN ---'; git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's#https://[^@]+@#https://***@#' || true; echo '--- CREDENTIAL HELPERS ---'; git config --show-origin --get-all credential.helper || true; echo '--- GIT CONFIG FILES ---'; git config --show-origin --list | sed -E 's#(https://)[^@]+@#\1***@#g' | grep -E 'credential|remote.origin.url|http\.' || true; echo '--- SUBMODULE CONTENT ---'; find map-k -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | head -20 || true; exit 1
